conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-risk positions. Expect lower volatility and more stable performance.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% monthly growth by managing risk while seeking opportunities. It reduces leverage and concentration, blending broad index with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by leveraging high-scoring setups and increasing exposure to leveraged ETFs. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware of daily decay/rebalancing in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid, substantial losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.
